# Carmel Valley Homes for Sale

> Carmel Valley single-family homes for sale in San Diego, CA 92130. Area, school-area and neighborhood guides with sold data, by Sez Sezer, Keller Williams Realty (DRE #01988197) - 858-436-6585, sez@carmelvalley.com, 12750 High Bluff Drive, San Diego, CA 92130.

Every page listed below has a clean Markdown version at the same path (index.md). The full text of every page is in [llms-full.txt](https://carmelvalleyhomesforsale.com/llms-full.txt). Median prices on these pages use the last 12 months of closed MLS sales; 5-year figures are shown as sale history (price ranges and recent sales). Condos and townhomes are covered at https://carmelvalleycondos.com, and every property type at https://carmelvalley.com.

## Overview

- [Carmel Valley Homes for Sale](https://carmelvalleyhomesforsale.com/index.md): Home page: Carmel Valley (San Diego, CA 92130) single-family homes for sale, 12-month market figures, areas, and how to work with Sez Sezer.
- [Carmel Valley Neighborhoods Map: Single-Family Homes by Area](https://carmelvalleyhomesforsale.com/carmel-valley-neighborhoods/index.md): Map of every single-family neighborhood in Carmel Valley, grouped by area, with home counts and what homes sold for.
- [Carmel Valley Schools Map: Homes by Elementary School Area](https://carmelvalleyhomesforsale.com/carmel-valley-schools/index.md): Map of Carmel Valley elementary school attendance areas (Del Mar Union SD), the neighborhoods in each, prices, middle and high schools, Solana Beach SD areas.
